summaries.text: This resolution expresses support for the designation of May 17, 2025, as DIPG Pediatric Brain Cancer Awareness Day. DIPG refers to diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma, a terminal childhood brain cancer.

title: A resolution expressing support for the designation of May 17, 2025, as "DIPG Pediatric Brain Cancer Awareness Day" to raise awareness of, and encourage research on, diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma tumors and pediatric cancers in general.
